name: bandit_camp
description: The Bandit Camp (camp/bandit_camp), the Lookout Camp, rebuilt from scratch for ROADMAP 49 (tools/blueprints/briefs/bandit_camp.md, REBUILD.md). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. Output goes to build/rebuild/bandit_camp/out; 'build' writes the candidate build/rebuild/bandit_camp/camp/bandit_camp.nbt (the ship step adds the loot chest's LootTable and takes the unused ground-layer cells out).

scripts.build: mkdir -p ../../../../build/rebuild/bandit_camp/camp && node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir ../../../../build/rebuild/bandit_camp/out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py bandit_camp camp/bandit_camp --candidate --nbt ../../../../build/rebuild/bandit_camp/out/bandit-camp.nbt
